title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated August 26, 2026, relative to City Council File No. 24-0018 –
text:
[5. REGULAR AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated August 26, 2026, relative to City Council File No. 24-0018 –
  Organized Retail Theft Prevention Grant Program – Budget Modification, as set forth.
  [BPC #26-253]
  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report and TRANSMIT to the Mayor and City Council.
summary: Approval of LAPD's budget change for its Organized Retail Theft Prevention grant, to be sent to the Mayor and City Council.
